title: Multicenter, controlled, randomized, observer-blinded clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of insulin eye drops (1 IU/ml) in the treatment of persistent corneal epithelial defect.
official: Multicenter, controlled, randomized, observer-blinded clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of insulin eye drops (1 IU/ml) in the treatment of persistent corneal epithelial defect.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of using insulin eye drops, comparing it with standard medical treatment (autologous serum eye drops), in the treatment of persistent epithelial defect of neurotrophic origin or secondary to chronic ocular surface diseases.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age over 18 years
2. Diagnosis of persistent corneal epithelial defect
3. Signature of informed consent
4. Negative serology for HIV, HCV, HBV, HLTV and syphilis.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnancy or lactation
2. Extreme stromal thinning (residual corneal thickness less than 60% of total corneal thickness).
3. Severe limbal corneal ischaemia (grade IV or higher on the Dua scale, 6 hours or more of limbal ischaemia).
